subject: MedSecure SIG intake: ownership, evidence roadmap, and scheduling
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <eortiz@medsecure.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedSecure SIG intake: ownership, evidence roadmap, and scheduling

Hi Elena — great to meet yesterday. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the SIG intake for MedSecure.

Recap from our call:
- Goal: complete SIG prefill and evidence handoff for initial security review; align on GDPR/HIPAA scope and SOC 2 status.
- MedSecure expects HIPAA coverage for PHI flows; you flagged EU residency concerns for a subset of customers.
- You asked for a clear owner on our side for evidence collection and a short working session with your security engineering team.

Asks / clarifying questions for you (so we can prefill accurately):
1) SOC 2: can you confirm whether a Type II in-scope date would be acceptable if we target Nov 2027? If you need an existing report today, please let me know that constraint.
2) Preferred questionnaire: do you want the SIG (standard SSAE/SIG mapping) or the CAIQ (cloud-specific) as the first deliverable? We can prefill both but want to avoid duplicated evidence work.
3) Evidence ownership: we propose Aditya Rao (cc'd) as our evidence owner/SE lead. Is that OK?
4) Data residency: please confirm which product environments need EU data residency (prod, staging, backups).
5) Timeline: target 3-week turnaround for prefill + 1-week for working session — does that fit your procurement window?

Attached: medsecure_SIG_prefill_v1.xlsx (starter answers), and a short network diagram we can share once you confirm NDA scope.

Proposed next steps:
- Aditya to own prefill updates and schedule a 60-min working session with your security engineer.
- We’ll provide an evidence map (what document maps to which SIG question) before the working session.

Available slots for the working session (PST): Tue 8/3 10:00–11:00, Wed 8/4 09:00–10:00, Thu 8/5 14:00–15:00. Pick one and we’ll send calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

—
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: medsecure_SIG_prefill_v1.xlsx (Excel)]
[Attachment: redwood_network_diagram.pdf (PDF, stub)]

From: Elena Ortiz <eortiz@medsecure.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@medsecure.com
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedSecure SIG intake: ownership, evidence roadmap, and scheduling

Rachel — thanks for the clear recap and the starter prefill. A few clarifying points from our side:

1) SOC 2: We prefer vendors with an existing SOC 2 Type II, but we can accept a SOC 2 in-progress plan if there are compensating controls and an ETA — target Nov 2027 is reasonable but we need written milestones (audit kickoff, coverage start, expected report date).
2) Questionnaire: SIG first is preferred since our GRC tooling ingests SIG/SSAE mappings. If you can provide CAIQ afterwards that’s fine.
3) HIPAA/GDPR: HIPAA must be in scope for production where PHI is processed. For GDPR we need confirmation of data processing addendum (DPA) and the list of sub-processors. Also clarify which EU regions host customer data.
4) Evidence: Can you provide your KMS/HSM attestation (vendor + region), encryption-in-transit certs, and a redacted SOC 2 control matrix if available? For network details, please include ingress/egress firewall rules at a high level — we only need a topology and where customer traffic terminates.

Working session: Wed 8/4 09:00 PST works for our security engineer (Amit Shah). Please send an invite with a short agenda: 1) evidence handoff, 2) open SIG questions, 3) timelines and milestones.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ortiz
Senior Information Security Manager
MedSecure
elena.ortiz@medsecure.com

Elena — thanks, that all makes sense and helpful constraints. Quick answers and what we’ll bring to the working session: 

SOC 2
- Status: SOC 2 Type II audit engagement is scheduled to start Sept 15, 2027. Target report delivery Nov 24, 2027. We’ll provide a milestones doc (audit engagement letter + coverage dates) before the call.

Questionnaire
- We will prioritize a SIG prefill and include a CAIQ export after the initial pass to avoid duplication.

HIPAA / GDPR / Sub-processors
- HIPAA: production environments handling PHI will be in-scope; we will attach a DPA template and list of sub-processors.
- GDPR: EU-hosted customer data currently resides in AWS eu-west-1 for EU-flagged accounts. We’ll include region mapping in the evidence pack.

Evidence items we will bring (attached / pre-shared prior to the working session):
- KMS/HSM provider and region + brief attestation (redacted)
- TLS encryption cert chain details (public certs)
- Redacted control matrix (SOC 2 mapping to SIG questions)
- Network topology (high level) — attached: redwood_network_diagram.pdf

Owner and cadence
- Aditya will be the evidence owner and will shepherd documents into your secure collection point. Aditya — can you confirm you can own the evidence map and post the files to the Drive link Rachel shared?

Working session invite: we’ll send Wed 8/4 09:00 PST with agenda as requested. Agenda draft: 1) Introductions + scope confirmation (10m) 2) Evidence map walk (25m) 3) Open SIG questions (20m) 4) Timeline & milestones (5m).

Thanks — we’ll be prepared.

—
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
